faq.question: Q1. What is Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by the Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Delhi Region, to recruit meritorious sportsperson candidates for 119 vacancies under the Sports Quota.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 119 vacancies are available under this recruitment cycle across Tax Assistant, Stenographer Grade II, and Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the post-wise vacancy distributions for Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 44 vacancies for Tax Assistant, 9 vacancies for Stenographer Grade II, and 66 vacancies for Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 10.11.2026 up to 23:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q5. When does the online application process start for Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process opens on 17.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Visit www.incometaxdelhi.gov.in, click on the Sports Recruitment tab and submit the online application between 17.10.2026 and 10.11.2026. Applications in any other form will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota posts?
faq.answer: Tax Assistant and Stenographer Grade II are placed in Pay Level - 4 (25500 to 81100). Multi-Tasking Staff is placed in Pay Level - 1 (18000 to 56900).
